gen-dafont-cheri-fs-bespoke-slab: Sturdy, friendly script with no hairlines at all. Bespoke Slab follows in a classic serif with tall bodies, grounded enough that Cheri's playful hand never runs away with a page of text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-abeezee: Dynamic and commanding, College draws its curves as thick as its stems, while ABeeZee sets down a friendly sans with terminals held clear of the stem. Approachable is its best trick.
gen-dafont-college-gf-aldrich: Chunky, confident, and tall in the lowercase. Aldrich sits beneath College as a sans-serif with cupped round letters and an x-height near the capitals, so both feel built from the same sturdy thread.
gen-dafont-college-gf-alexandria: Round letters with walls as heavy as the straight ones give College its muscle, and Alexandria steps in below as a sans with wide open terminals and a tall body, lightening the load.
gen-dafont-college-gf-amiko: Modern, with a heavy-handed heading. College gives every stroke the same visual weight, and Amiko brings outward-pointing terminals and tall lowercase that make the shift to text feel quick and easy.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-bangla: College hits hard, with every stroke carrying equal weight. Anek Bangla takes over in a sans with broad s curves and a short climb to the ascender, so the page loosens up right below the heading.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-devanagari: Authoritative is College all over, with every letter built from one width of stroke and big counters in a tall lowercase. Anek Devanagari softens the landing with openly shaped letter mouths.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati reads clean and approachable, its lowercase nearly rivaling the capitals and its c gaping wide. Against College's wire-like monoline skeleton, it adds friendliness without losing any of the heading's punch.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-gurmukhi: College draws a plain, unshaded line that never swells, giving it a stamped-out authority. And Anek Gurmukhi reads easily over a long stretch, thanks to big open counters in every small letter.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-kannada: Cable-like and bold, College bends its strokes without any swelling or thinning. Anek Kannada then lifts its x-height high, a sans-serif whose terminals stop far from the stem, so the two stand tall together.
